Error Prevention Strategies

ENGINEERING CONTROLS:

☐ Mistake-proofing (Poka-yoke) devices ☐ Color-coded parts and connectors

☐ Automated test equipment ☐ Torque wrenches with audio alerts

☐ RFID part tracking ☐ Digital work cards

ADMINISTRATIVE CONTROLS:

☐ Dual inspection (RII) for critical tasks ☐ Maintenance error investigation program

☐ Pre-task briefings ☐ Post-task debriefs

☐ Safety alerts and bulletins ☐ Regular competency assessments

☐ Fatigue risk management system ☐ Shift handover procedures

CULTURAL CONTROLS:

☐ Just culture reporting ☐ No-blame policy for unintentional errors

☐ Safety observation program ☐ Management visibility and engagement

☐ Peer-to-peer coaching ☐ Reward and recognition for error prevention
